name_en: THE RULES EVERY HEAL PLATE OBEYS — paste these blocks into every prompt below
what_this_is: A healing VFX plate, generated as a clip and packed into one sprite sheet by tools/pack-video-sheet.mjs, exactly like the breath, slam and claw sheets already in src/assets/fx. It is composited on top of the game by src/fx/vfx.js with the add blend, so it is never drawn over a background and never carries one.
where_it_lands: director.js:1589 — heroRow.healAll(this.healTo()) on ARISSA's ultimate, and the same family scaled up for a boss self-heal if one is ever wired. The heal the game plays today is the party heal: sfx.heal(), then every card heals with a 0.06 s stagger, the card tint runs from its gem light to white over 0.4 s, the card punches to 1.1 in 0.14 s and settles back over 0.28 s backOut, the HP gauge fills over 0.5 s, and hud.shout(COPY.ultHeal) goes up in 0x9fffc4.
stage_en: The effect is alone on a flat, evenly lit chroma-key green studio backdrop — a seamless green studio cyclorama, the same solid green from edge to edge, and nothing else is in frame: no floor, no ground plane, no room, no landscape, no wall, no altar, no pedestal, no creature, no monster, no character, no hand, no plant, no leaf, no water, no smoke, no haze, no atmospheric glow, no shadow cast on the green. The green is a plain backdrop and is never lit by the effect: it does not brighten, glow, flicker, darken or change colour anywhere, not even at the peak of the burst, and no green light spills into the effect, whose own green stays a saturated emerald and never sinks into the backdrop.
framing_en: The effect is centred and fills the middle two thirds of the frame at its widest, never cropped at any edge, and its centre never moves off the middle of the frame. Square frame. Single continuous shot, one fixed locked-off camera, no cuts, no shot changes, no camera movement, no zoom, no push in, no pan, no tilt, no orbit, no shake, no parallax.
one_beat_en: Exactly one heal in the whole clip: it gathers once, peaks once and clears once. No second pulse, no repeat, no loop, nothing before it and nothing after it. The first frame is empty and the last frame is empty — nothing is left behind, no lingering ring, no residue, no permanent magic circle on the ground or in the air.
never_en: No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no logo, no UI, no health bar, no heart, no cross, no plus sign, no runes that read as writing, no lens flare, no bloom washing over the whole frame, no vignette, no depth of field, no film grain, no motion blur smear.
black_swap_en: For the black-background variant, replace the stage block with: The effect is isolated on a pure flat black background, nothing else in frame — no floor, no ground plane, no room, no landscape, no wall, no pedestal, no creature, no character, no plant, no water, no smoke, no haze. Nothing in the frame is lit except the healing energy itself, and the background is fully black again on the last frame.
colour_en: Emerald 0x3fd16a through pale mint 0xb6f5c9 into a warm gold-white core 0xfff2d0, to agree with the mint the heal shout already goes up in (0x9fffc4) and to stay clear of every attack sheet in the set, which are all orange. No red, no orange, no fire, no lava, no molten anything, no blue, no violet.
grid_en: 5 cols x 228 px square cells, 10 frames — the SHEET constant in src/art/spells.js cuts every *-sheet.webp in src/assets/fx to that grid, so any other layout silently tears. Generate the clip at the full 1.70 s and let the packer resample to 10, or ask for 14 and pack down with --range weighted on the peak.
references_en: 1. the game screenshot — STYLE ONLY: painted 3D mobile-RPG rendering, semi-realistic, high contrast, how light is painted. Never its board, gems, cards, heroes or layout.
2. src/assets/fx/nature-sheet.webp and src/assets/fx/arcane-sheet.webp — the family the green has to sit inside: same weight of paint, same core-to-edge falloff, same ribbon language.
3. src/assets/fx/slam-sheet.webp — the opposite silhouette on purpose. That one is an impact going out; this one gathers in before it opens.

name_en: HEAL — the party heal burst, ARISSA's ultimate, director.js healAll
hits: all four hero cards to healTo() — ULT_HEAL_TO 0.6, decaying 0.1 a use, floored at ULT_HEAL_FLOOR 0.32
grid: 5 cols x 228 px square cells, 10 frames, the same SHEET as every other spell
wiring: the sheet loads itself — spells.js globs ../assets/fx/*-sheet.webp, so dropping heal-sheet.webp there makes spellFrames('heal') live with no code change. To play it: add heal to BOSS_SPELLS (or a thin vfx.heal(at, opts) beside bossSwing) and call vfx.bossSwing('heal', rowCentre, { size: rowW * 0.9, duration: 0.62, grow: 0.34 }) from director.js:1589, on the same beat as heroRow.healAll.
beat: 0.00-0.25 s the core forms. 0.25-0.60 s the aura grows and the ribbons start their spiral — the window the cards are punching to 1.1 in. 0.60-0.95 s peak, the same beat the card tint hits white and the gauges are half filled. 0.95-1.35 s the aura opens outward and starts to go. 1.35-1.70 s the motes rise out and the frame is empty.
colour_en: golden-green healing energy: emerald 0x3fd16a in the ribbons, pale mint 0xb6f5c9 in the aura, a warm gold-white core 0xfff2d0 that is the brightest thing in the frame at the peak. No red, no orange, no fire.
prompt_en: Match the art style of the reference game screenshot exactly: painted 3D mobile-RPG game art, semi-realistic fantasy magic, high contrast, saturated luminous colour with a bright warm core, no flat cartoon shading, no anime line art, no pixel art. Take only the rendering style from that screenshot; do not copy its background, its board, its gems, its cards, its heroes, its boss or any part of its layout. One healing spell blooms in the centre of the frame and clears. It starts as a single small concentrated core of light, no wider than a coin, and soft golden-green energy gathers into it out of the air around it until it opens into a luminous circular aura, brightest at the middle and falling off to a translucent emerald edge. Thin streams of magic spiral upward around that centre — several translucent golden-green ribbons, wide and soft-edged like poured light rather than drawn lines, turning in one controlled direction, never tangling, never crossing into a knot — and small glowing particles and fine sparks ride up with them. The energy builds smoothly: the ribbons tighten inward as they rise, converge on the core, and the core answers by flaring to its maximum brightness, a warm gold-white heart inside the green, and pushing one soft clean pulse outward through the aura. It is a strong burst but a clean one: the shape stays readable, the edges stay crisp, the light never smears into a white blob and never fills the frame. After the peak the aura keeps expanding gently outward and thins as it goes, the ribbons unwind and dissolve from the outside in, and the particles drift upward and fade out one by one. The core is the last thing to go. Every trace of it is gone by the end and the last frame is completely empty and clean. Golden-green and emerald throughout with a warm golden-white core, never red, never orange, never a flame, never lava, never smoke, never embers, never liquid water. [ONE_BEAT] [STAGE] [FRAMING] [NEVER]

note_en: --flood matters more here than on any other sheet in the set: the effect is green on a green key, so a flat colour key eats the ribbons. Key it as a flood from the border with --reach loose and --similarity tight, or generate the black plate and use --opaque, which is the safer road for a green effect and a third of the file size on top of that, since the sheet goes on with the add blend anyway.

3. src/assets/fx/arcane-sheet.webp — the ribbon language: soft wide bands of light, not drawn strokes.

name_en: HEAL MOTE — the small one that lands on each hero card, card.heal
hits: one card, four of them 0.06 s apart
grid: 5 cols x 228 px square cells, 10 frames
wiring: vfx.bossSwing('healmote', cardTop, { size: cardW * 0.8, duration: 0.42, grow: 0.2 }) from heroes.js card.heal, on the same wait the tint and the punch already use.
beat: 0.42 s end to end, to sit inside the card's own punch: 0.00-0.10 s a mote drops in, 0.10-0.24 s it opens, 0.24-0.42 s it lifts off the card and is gone. Much smaller and much faster than the party burst, and it never competes with it.
colour_en: the same emerald-to-gold-white ramp as the party heal but thinner and cooler at the edge, so four of them firing across the row do not add up to a white wall

name_en: BOSS MEND — the same magic pulled inward instead of pushed out, if the boss ever heals itself
hits: nothing is wired to this today; it exists so the boss version is not improvised later in a different green
grid: 5 cols x 228 px square cells, 10 frames
wiring: vfx.bossSwing('mend', bossChest, { size: bossW * 1.1, duration: 0.7, grow: -0.25 }) — note the negative grow: this one closes on the boss instead of opening off it.
beat: 0.00-0.40 s the motes gather from the edges of the frame. 0.40-0.75 s they wind inward into a tight core. 0.75-1.10 s the core takes one deep pulse and sinks. 1.10-1.60 s the last threads are drawn in and the frame is empty.
colour_en: the same emerald and gold-white, one stop darker and more saturated than the party heal so the boss reads as taking the magic, not giving it
prompt_en: Match the art style of the reference game screenshot exactly: painted 3D mobile-RPG game art, semi-realistic fantasy magic, high contrast, saturated luminous colour with a bright warm core, no flat cartoon shading, no anime line art, no pixel art. Take only the rendering style from that screenshot; never its background, its board, its cards or any part of its layout. One healing spell that runs inward, and nothing else. Loose golden-green motes and fine sparks drift in from the edges of the frame towards its centre, gathering and speeding up as they come. They draw themselves into thin translucent emerald ribbons that spiral inward and downward, wrapping tighter and tighter around a point in the middle until a warm gold-white core lights inside them. The core takes one single deep pulse — it swells, brightens and settles rather than bursting, and the light never throws outward past the ribbons. Then everything collapses into it: the ribbons are pulled in and swallowed, the last stray motes chase them down, and the core dims out from the edge to the middle. The final frame is completely empty and clean, with nothing left behind. The whole effect moves inward and downward from start to finish, never outward, never upward, never a shockwave, never a ring crossing the frame. Golden-green and emerald with a warm golden-white core, never red, never orange, never fire, never lava, never smoke, never embers. [ONE_BEAT] [STAGE] [FRAMING] [NEVER]
